title: Flashlight Cave
shareTitle: Flashlight Cave 🔦 — Find Letters in the Dark with Ari
description: Drag a beam of light around a dark cave with Ari the armadillo to find glowing letters, hear their names and sounds, and meet the friends hiding in the alcoves — apple, ant or alligator for A, and so on through all 26 letters. Three search modes for ages 5–6, driven entirely by voice, pictures and touch.
learningGoals: Recognize any of the 26 uppercase letters when it is named aloud
Match a spoken phoneme to the letter that makes it (phoneme to grapheme)
Identify the letter a spoken or pictured word starts with (initial-sound identification)
Discriminate confusable letter shapes (B/D/P/R, M/N/W, O/Q/C/G, ...) under time-free, no-pressure conditions
Build vocabulary through 78 illustrated, spoken "A is for apple" pairings
interactionModel: The beam of light follows the child's finger directly — there is no handle to grab, and the beam persists after release so the child can look, then tap. A prompt names the target letter first; the child drags or taps to move the light until the letter is lit, then taps it to answer. A tap on a letter that is not lit simply moves the light — it is never scored as a wrong answer, because the child cannot have meant to answer a letter they cannot see. Tap-to-move is an equal, easier path to the same drag gesture, and arrow keys plus Enter/Space give a full keyboard-only route through the identical handler.
feedbackModel: A correct, lit tap triggers a star burst, the beam floods the alcove, the object springs out with "[Letter] is for [word]!", Ari cheers, and a progress pip fills. A lit but wrong tap gets a soft wobble and sound, one of three escalating-in-helpfulness nudges from Ari, and the same prompt again — nothing is lost, nothing reshuffles, and input returns within 1.5 seconds. Three graduated hints (how to move the light, that a found letter can be tapped, then a beam glide toward the answer) always model the next step and never solve it outright. There is no score, no streak, no timer and no failure state anywhere in the game.
